activation_source.clause: DATES: July24 00:01 eastern activation and July28 00:01 eastern transit cutoff; visually checked

blockers.reason: The RuleSpec Day interval loses the 00:01 eastern entry cutoff. July28 entries at00:00:00 and00:00:59 with qualifying loading/transit satisfy heading9903.05.85, but the program returns no safe harbor and a positive component for covered origins. An entry timestamp/precision contract and supervised RuleSpec repair are required before admitting this scope.

general_note11.clause: General note11(a)-(b), PDF page1; complete136-page original captured, actual qualification not derived

limitations: The loading/transit Boolean stipulates all vessel, port, final-mode and July24 00:01 eastern conditions; carrier evidence is not supplied.
USMCA free-duty treatment remains a stipulated fact subject to GeneralNote11 and CBP entry requirements, not a conclusion from origin alone.
The daily control cases stipulate noon eastern entry time. The additional minute probes expose rather than hide the incompatible time granularity.

The sports-ball HTS witness is a preexisting nonexempt projection; the generated composition explicitly stipulates entry_is_forced_labor_301_listed=true and other exception flags=false; this batch does not certify product membership, total duty, or every generated chapter.
